items.title: Shayna Jack announces swimming retirement on eve of Commonwealth Games
items.description: Gold medal-winning Australian swimmer Shayna Jack says she will retire at the end of the Commonwealth Games.

items.title: The worrying statistic around Indigenous players in the AFLW
items.description: Racism remains a key issue for First Nations AFL players, while Indigenous AFLW players rate their workplace culture significantly lower than their peers, a new report finds.

items.title: Melbourne mother accused of showing IS propaganda to her children
items.description: Police allege a Melbourne woman facing terrorism charges showed Islamic State propaganda videos to her children about slaughtering "disbelievers."

items.title: Spy agency warns active Russian hackers targeting Australian industry
items.description: The Australian Signals Directorate says hackers are trying to access information through network devices, such as laptops, which use old software and predictable passwords.

items.title: What we know about the alleged murder of Jana Armstrong
items.description: The search for Toowoomba mother Jana Armstrong ended in tragedy. Here's what police say happened to the young mother.

items.title: Trump's IRS settlement tried to 'manipulate' court, judge says
items.description: US President Donald Trump's lawsuit against his own government over leaked tax records was an unparalleled exercise in self-dealing, a US judge says in a scathing ruling.

items.title: A 60-year-old law could decide if Australia gets billions in AI investments
items.description: Tens of billions of dollars in investment, and Australia's ambition to become a global AI power, could hinge on a law written in 1968 for an era of black-and-white television, film and radio.

items.title: Teen rushed to hospital after Brisbane school stabbing
items.description: Emergency services were called to the Islamic College of Brisbane in Karawatha just before midday after reports of an altercation between two students.

items.title: Middle East 'chaos' could see millions of motorists slugged again as oil surges

items.title: New Jewish students apprehensive about being on campus, commission hears
items.description: The president of a Jewish student body tells antisemitism royal commission that he had a relatively untroubled childhood until he went to university.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
